P R OF ES S I ON A L  EX P ER I EN CE 
STATE STREET | Hyderabad 
Senior Associate – Private Equity Fund Accounting Mar 2022 – Apr 2026 
• Managed end-to-end fund accounting and the daily book of records for multiple Private Equity Master and 
Feeder funds, ensuring accurate reporting in line with fund documentation. 
• Prepared and reviewed Monthly, Quarterly and Annual NAV packs, covering investor allocations, capital 
balances, and reconciliation of fund assets and liabilities. 
• Processed capital calls, investor contributions, distributions and commitment tracking, maintaining accurate 
investor capital accounts and commitment schedules. 
• Calculated and accrued management fees, performance fees / carried interest, tax and audit fees in accordance 
with LPAs and fund agreements. 
• Recorded complex journal entries — investment transactions, accruals, unrealized gains/losses, fair value 
adjustments and cash movements — on Investran (SunGard). 
• Performed cash, bank, GP capital, FMV and investment position reconciliations, investigating and resolving 
exceptions within SLA timelines. 
• Prepared monthly P&L, GP and Firm capital statements, cash memos and investor reports supporting 
management reporting and financial analysis. 
• Reviewed LPAs, PPMs and fund structures — standalone, Master –Feeder and GP/LP — to ensure correct 
accounting treatment and regulatory compliance. 
• Led daily workflow planning, reviewed team deliverables and mentored junior analysts, ensuring adherence to 
quality standards, internal controls and client SLAs. 
• Supported new fund launches, take-on and external audits — validating controls, implementing client template 
changes, preparing audit schedules and coordinating with fund managers, auditors and tax teams. 
BROADRIDGE FINANCIAL SOLUTIONS | Bangalore 
Process Analyst – Principal & Interest Oct 2019 – Feb 2022 
• Processed principal and interest (coupon) payments for fixed income securities, ensuring timely settlement on 
coupon and maturity dates. 
• Created and maintained payable and receivable records by validating stock positions and applying applicable 
DTCC rates and settlement information. 
• Performed principal and coupon entitlement calculations using stock records, security details and payment 
rates for accurate client settlements. 
• Coordinated with internal teams, counterparties and clients to confirm instructions, resolve discrepancies and 
release payments post client confirmation. 
• Managed receivable collections through Nomura Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) or Standing Payment 
Orders (SPO) per client preference.

• Best Performer Award and Pinnacle Award, State Street — for operational excellence in Private Equity fund 
accounting. 
• Achieved 100% quality score for consecutive quarters at Broadridge Financial Solutions.
